name: security-flux-source-delegation-review
intent: Flux source reconciliation and impersonated deployment identity
artifacts: Source/Kustomization/HelmRelease resources, cross-namespace references, serviceAccountName and controller flags.
trace: Trace who can reference or alter a source and which identity applies its rendered resources. Distinguish controller identity from per-reconciliation impersonation.
experiment: Use an isolated fixture with two owned namespaces and inert manifests; compare intended source/account with a forbidden cross-namespace reference.
disproof: A source download alone is not privileged application; record the actual apply authority and admitted objects.
repair: Bind source references and reconciliation identities to tenants, preserving valid dependency and rollout behavior.
branch_decisions: Trace source artifact revision/digest into the Kustomization or HelmRelease and its effective serviceAccountName/controller identity. Source read access does not equal deployment edit authority. A namespace boundary can be crossed through allowed references only if the actual controller configuration and impersonated identity permit it; inspect cross-namespace-reference policy explicitly.
